# Paprs (paprs.app)

> Paprs is an intelligent, step-by-step guidance platform for navigating Spanish bureaucracy, immigration, residency, and taxes.

## Overview
Paprs helps expats, digital nomads, remote workers, students, and autonomous contractors in Spain handle complex administrative processes without stress or exorbitant gestoría fees.

## Core Features & Modules
- **NIE & TIE**: Step-by-step appointment booking (Cita Previa), document checklists, form completion guides (EX-15, EX-18, EX-17), and regional requirements.
- **Empadronamiento (Padrón)**: Town hall registration guides for Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, and across all Spanish autonomous communities.
- **Autónomo Engine**: Freelancer registration (Alta en Hacienda Modelo 036/037, Seguridad Social RETA), quarterly VAT (IVA Modelo 303), income tax (IRPF Modelo 130), and flat-rate cuota reducida optimization.
- **Digital Nomad Visa & Beckham Law**: Eligibility calculation, application timeline, required documents, apostilles, and sworn translations.
- **Document Vault**: Encrypted cloud storage for certificates, padrón volante, bank statements, and tax returns with expiration alerts.
- **Dynamic Timeline**: Personalized relocation roadmap tailored to citizenship, visa type, and destination city.

## Technical Architecture
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4, dark mode first
- **Internationalization**: English and Spanish multi-language support
- **Hosting & APIs**: Edge-optimized, Supabase PostgreSQL & Auth
